current_phase.name: Phase 2 - Hardening + New Features
current_phase.description: Core platform is built. Phase 2 focuses on fixing half-done features, closing security gaps, and building next features (Pools/AMM, Notifications, enhanced Swap, etc.).

completed_work.name: Authentication + Role System
completed_work.description: Supabase Auth (email/Google), user_roles table, admin gate

completed_work.name: KYC Flow
completed_work.description: Full Stripe Identity integration: kyc-start, kyc-save, kyc-submit, kyc-admin-review, stripe-identity-webhook. Status polling, admin review UI.

completed_work.name: Wallet Compliance Layer
completed_work.description: wallet-register, wallet-approve, compliance-check. WalletRegistrationPanel, TradeGuard. XRPL Credentials (ACCOUNTABUL_TRADE_APPROVED). Full 6-step flow.

completed_work.name: Credentials System
completed_work.description: Credential type registry, eligibility engine, apply-for-credential, auto-issue-credential, credential-accept, review-credential-application, revoke-credential, issue-testnet-credential. Full admin UI.

completed_work.name: Swap Engine
completed_work.description: xrpl-build-swap with PathFind, xrpl-sponsor-trustline, property token pricing, Xaman signing flow, TokenPickerDialog.

completed_work.name: Campaigns / Causes
completed_work.description: campaign-donate (XRPL EscrowCreate), campaign-check-donation (Xaman poll), campaign-release (escrow finish). CauseApply, CauseDetail, DonateModal.

completed_work.name: GitHub Agent
completed_work.description: github-agent edge function: JWT signing, installation tokens, file tree, file read, issue CRUD, PR creation, memory (store/recall). Bidirectional sync with action_items table.

completed_work.name: AI Panel (Debate)
completed_work.description: ai-debate edge function streaming with Claude/GPT/Gemini. Round-based turns, transcript summarization, action item generation → action_items table, GitHub sync. Admin-only gate.

completed_work.name: Action Items
completed_work.description: ActionItems page: CRUD, priority/status filters, GitHub issue push, closed-issue poll-back to mark done.

completed_work.name: Property Tokenization Pipeline
completed_work.description: tokenization-pipeline edge function: GET /mine, GET / (admin), PATCH status. Draft→submitted→under_review→approved/rejected workflow.

completed_work.name: Security Hardening
completed_work.description: CORS locked to APP_ALLOWED_ORIGIN. RLS policies tightened (xaman_payloads, wallet tables). wallet_secret column dropped. Stripe webhook dev-fallback removed. Faucet gated behind JWT.

completed_work.name: Mint Wizard
completed_work.description: MintWizard: MPT/NFT/IOU form steps. xrpl-build-mint edge function builds and submits via Xaman. MintStatus polling.

high.title: campaign-release hardcodes testnet
high.description: network='testnet' is hardcoded. Mainnet escrows never auto-release; always fall back to manual Xaman. Admin success toast fires even when nothing released on mainnet.

medium.title: CauseApply no auth gate — guest form submit fails silently
AI Panel allows unrestricted repo file access via github-agent
Professionals page has no data source — pure placeholder
medium.description: Page renders but no hook, no DB table referenced. Needs a professionals table or removal from nav.

medium.title: Compliance state can go stale mid-trade
medium.description: useWalletCompliance caches compliance result in React Query. If a wallet is revoked server-side, the frontend won't reflect it until next refetch (30s poll). A revoked user could submit a swap in the window.

low.title: Mint wizard lacks re-submit protection if tx is dropped
low.description: If XRPL drops a submitted tx, there's no guard preventing a double-mint. Low risk on testnet, higher on mainnet.

security_items.description: Wallet address and network stored in localStorage. Not private data per se, but worth noting. No secret keys stored here post wallet_secret removal.

context_notes: Platform is Accountabul — RWA tokenization + social hub on XRPL
Stack: React + TypeScript + Supabase (PostgreSQL + Edge Functions in Deno)
All XRPL interactions go through edge functions — no browser XRPL calls
Wallet signing uses Xaman (QR-code) for user-facing ops; edge-function signer seed for admin auto-sign
Team access = admin role in user_roles table
Lovable auto-commits to GitHub — always pull before pushing
XRPL_TESTNET_ISSUER_SEED, ACCOUNTABUL_ISSUER_ADDRESS, APP_ALLOWED_ORIGIN, GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY must be set in Supabase Edge Function Secrets
AI Panel uses ai-debate edge function — streams NDJSON, requires OPENAI_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secrets
